
AUTO-ADVANCE
Automatically advance work units through workflow when criteria are met

WHEN TO USE
  Use to automatically move work units forward when they meet criteria (e.g., all questions answered → move to testing).

USAGE
  fspec auto-advance [options]

OPTIONS
  --dry-run
    Show what would be advanced without making changes

EXAMPLES
  1. Auto-advance eligible work units
  $ fspec auto-advance
  ✓ AUTH-001: specifying → testing (all questions answered)
✓ AUTH-002: testing → implementing (tests written)

Advanced 2 work units

  2. Preview auto-advance
  $ fspec auto-advance --dry-run
  Would advance: AUTH-001 (specifying → testing)

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec update-work-unit-status
  fspec board

NOTES
  • Checks ACDD workflow criteria for each state
  • Safe to run multiple times (idempotent)
